scope: PDF/PPTX source extraction, unit grouping/splitting, KB primary/omission construction and quote checks. Fresh source inspection preceded reading the new source test harness. No prior audit report read.

safeguardInventory.name: PPTX relationship order
safeguardInventory.evidence: ZIP presentation relationship IDs and slide paths; body/notes DrawingML text nodes
safeguardInventory.predicate: Use presentation.xml sldId relationship order when it resolves to existing slide entries; numeric filenames only if no slides resolve.
safeguardInventory.effect: Changes source ordering; emits slide labels and speaker notes.
safeguardInventory.errors: JSZip absent/no slides throws. Malformed presentation fallback may recover. XML parse errors are not explicitly inspected.
safeguardInventory.laterLimit: No visual/table/diagram semantics validated; no native ZIP/XML execution in this review.

safeguardInventory.name: PDF worker and walk
safeguardInventory.evidence: SRI-verified worker bytes, PDF text runs
safeguardInventory.predicate: Verified worker ownership current; each page requires nonaborted signal; cleanup in finally.
safeguardInventory.effect: Rejects failed worker/document/page read; coordinates reconstruct line breaks.
safeguardInventory.errors: Per-file extraction catch 2721 reports error and continues; AbortError terminates build.
safeguardInventory.laterLimit: pdfLayoutText is layout heuristic, not reading-order/clinical correctness proof.

safeguardInventory.name: Sparse source warning
safeguardInventory.evidence: Extracted page/slide text length after label removal
safeguardInventory.predicate: q.avg < 100 OR q.empty >= ceil(q.pages*0.6), with nearly-empty page threshold 50 chars.
safeguardInventory.effect: Adds problem/log but source still reaches generation.
safeguardInventory.errors: kbBuildSourceChunks catches quality calculation/callback exceptions silently.
safeguardInventory.laterLimit: A injected throw demonstrates catch behavior only. Production helper inputs are constructed plain strings; natural quality failure not reproduced.

safeguardInventory.name: Composition probe
safeguardInventory.evidence: PDF getOperatorList counts and per-document medians
safeguardInventory.predicate: Only runs if opt-in composition flag truthy.
safeguardInventory.effect: Diagnostics only; no routing or admission.
safeguardInventory.errors: Per-page getOperatorList rejection and summary/callback failures swallowed.
safeguardInventory.laterLimit: Not a scanned-source warning gate; quality warning does not depend on composition.

safeguardInventory.name: Unit grouping
safeguardInventory.evidence: One emitted page/slide unit with text and source number
safeguardInventory.predicate: Flush group before adding next unit when sum would exceed maxChars; overlap copies trailing units of preceding original group.
safeguardInventory.effect: No input unit removed; overlap can exceed nominal maxChars.
safeguardInventory.errors: Oversized single unit retained and later can split.
safeguardInventory.laterLimit: Lossless bytes at grouping excluding added newlines is not proof of semantic continuity.

safeguardInventory.name: Truncation splitting
safeguardInventory.evidence: Transport truncated metadata and source units
safeguardInventory.predicate: At least two units => halves by unit count; otherwise text length >=2000 => nearest paragraph/newline within 20%-80%, else midpoint; retry only while job.depth < 4.
safeguardInventory.effect: Requeues both halves before parse; source unit labels remain truthful; text halves trim outer whitespace.
safeguardInventory.errors: Too short/depth limit reports failed chunk; partial JSON not committed.
safeguardInventory.laterLimit: Hard cut may divide a proposition and halves have no seam overlap. No demonstrated content-loss reproduction; characterize as context risk rather than defect.

safeguardInventory.name: Primary response structure
safeguardInventory.predicate: Only parsed non-null and Array.isArray(parsed.conditions) inside chunk catch.
safeguardInventory.effect: Top-level malformed data becomes failed chunk; completed chunks retained.
safeguardInventory.errors: Nested null condition dereference outside per-chunk catch aborts entire build; final outer catch leaves earlier completed parts unpublished.

safeguardInventory.name: Quote occurrence
safeguardInventory.evidence: Model quote compared only against chunk text, not fact proposition
safeguardInventory.predicate: Lowercase ASCII alphanumeric normalization; normalized quote length >=10; sourceNorm.includes(q), else dehyphenated substring.
safeguardInventory.effect: Pass 1 counts nonempty quote misses but retains fact; pass 2 discards failed quote; empty pass-1 quote skipped.
safeguardInventory.errors: No semantic entailment comparison, word-edge check, or source-pointer verification.
safeguardInventory.laterLimit: A correct quote attached to false fact can pass; new numeric-prefix quote reproduction proves changed number at trailing token edge can also pass.

safeguardInventory.name: Operator disagreement
safeguardInventory.predicate: No operator => true, else operator-word-normalized substring in source.
safeguardInventory.effect: Counts separate opMismatch diagnostic, never rejects or rewrites.
safeguardInventory.errors: No false result feeds discard condition.
safeguardInventory.laterLimit: WARN behavior is explicitly approved; do not report retained inverted comparator as implementation defect.

safeguardInventory.name: Omission response structure
safeguardInventory.effect: Wrong-shaped object treated as zero missed with +0 recovered log.
safeguardInventory.errors: Actual throw reports audit failure; malformed successful JSON shape does not.
safeguardInventory.laterLimit: verified flag at 2864 reflects requested verifyPass, not completion; confirmed A6.

safeguardInventory.name: Merge identity and provenance
safeguardInventory.evidence: bucket+subtype+whitespace-normalized fact text; model first-pass sourcePointer
safeguardInventory.predicate: Exact conservative fact key dedupes and unions filename/location.
safeguardInventory.effect: Reassigns local fact-N IDs; first matching fact content/tier retained; part.source.filename is real file but each first-pass fact pointer is trusted.
safeguardInventory.errors: No pointer filename or page-range membership check.
safeguardInventory.laterLimit: A7 proves fabricated never-read.pdf/page999 fact provenance reaches KB packet/export; pass2 overrides pointer correctly at 2826.

safeguardInventory.name: Underextraction and publication
safeguardInventory.evidence: Per-chunk char/fact counts, bucket presence and replacement-operation token
safeguardInventory.predicate: Failed/zero/sparse/below-median diagnostics; no parts => throw; current(run) required before K.setKnowledgeBase.
safeguardInventory.effect: Warns diagnostically, retains low-density content; blocks stale publication.
safeguardInventory.errors: Outer exception does not commit accumulated parts.
safeguardInventory.laterLimit: No semantic completeness proof; source test mutation kills publication guard removal.

conclusions.limits: Current fixture contains sparse-source warning solely because synthetic text is short; there is no quote-specific diagnostic. Does not claim full semantic entailment from exact quote.

conclusions.actual: Wrong red fact with genuine green sourceQuote passes quote checks; mocked faithful red Anki note exports linked and lint-clean.
conclusions.classification: Quote occurrence is not proposition support. No unapproved semantic gate recommended as bug fix.

conclusions.actual: Inverted comparator recovered and opMismatch=1, as current explicit WARN policy requires.
Source test injects throwing kbTextQuality replacement and observes no diagnostic.
conclusions.refutation: This proves error swallowing, not reachable failure of real kbTextQuality on the plain string units constructed in production; composition failure cannot suppress independent text quality.

conclusions.actual: Real MAX_TOKENS split control requeues both halves and publishes both complete responses.
conclusions.limit: Hard-cut semantic seam risk remains unmeasured; no source text silently dropped except edge whitespace trimming.
